notes.title: DID YOU KNOW? - Weapon Showcase
notes.notes:
[h2]Weapons Showcase[/h2][p]
In [b]Drunkonauts[/b], almost anything can be a weapon. If you swing it hard enough.
Some tools are made to fix things. Others are made to cause problems.

If you can hold it, you can throw it.

Today, we’re looking at two simple items that hit harder than they should. Choose your favorite 👇


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586596/2aa7972508824ea661c84ae0187703f3bc1a9b1b.png"][/img][/p][h3]The Sawblade[/h3][p]
Fast and sharp. Totally unsafe.

🪽 This blade isn’t attached to anything, it’s just meant to fly.
💨 It’s lightweight, fast, and very satisfying to land a hit with.
❓ Just don’t ask where it came from.

The ultimate “don’t think, just throw” weapon.
Best for players who enjoy danger as much as victory.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586596/93294436d4031beab9a57271bed2926202e0c50e.png"][/img][/p][h3]The Shovel[/h3][p]
Simple. Heavy. Effective.

✅ 0% subtle, 100% gets the job done.
🪦 You can dig your own grave with it... or someone else’s.
🎯 You can also throw it to surprise your opponents.

Sometimes simple is best.
For players who want one tool for all problems.



[/p][h3]In [b]Drunkonauts[/b], any object can be dangerous.[/h3][p]
Not all of them explode. Some just… hurt a lot.

Would you use the spinning blade or the heavy shovel?
🌀 [b]Sawblade[/b] — fast and wild
🪏 [b]Shovel[/b] — strong and simple

Simple tools still work in space. Pick the one that fits your playstyle.

[/p][p]
🚀 Stay tuned for more deep dives into the weird and wonderful world of [b]Drunkonauts[/b].

notes.title: DID YOU KNOW? - JETPACKS 101
notes.notes:
[h2]JETPACKS 101[/h2][p]

In [b]Drunkonauts[/b], jetpacks aren’t optional. They’re your way out, your way up, and your way into trouble. And maybe the way to show off a little too.
From dodging slowing goo to outsmart your friends on an alien jungle map, mastering your pack means mastering the chaos.


They're flashy, unpredictable, and full of personality.
Two of the jetpack styles. Same chaos. Choose your favorite 👇

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586596/860c90d46b88325ded0c8c41fd3bbca482a6481d.png"][/img][/p][h3]The Classic[/h3][p]
It's clean and reliable. The jetpack everyone recognizes.
⚙️ It doesn’t [i]sparkle[/i]. It doesn’t [i]fizz[/i]. It just [b]works[/b].
✨ The one you grew up dreaming about.
Don’t let the basic look fool you.
If you’re the kind of player who lets your skills do the talking, this one's for you.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586596/a6202b4fc2e20188620bf66d332fe5b1c9bdbd59.png"][/img][/p][h3]The Bubbler[/h3][p]
Two beer bottles. One jetpack. Zero dignity.
🍻 100% party fuel. 0% safety regulations.
🫧 Engineered by someone with a hangover and a dream.
Why settle for “cool” when you can rocket around like you borrowed your fuel from the fridge?
Perfect for slipping out of a fight with style or crashing into one with zero regrets. Because why not fly with carbonated confidence?

[/p][h3]In [b]Drunkonauts[/b], style is half the battle.[/h3][p]
Whether you’re keeping it clean with [b]The Classic[/b] or going full chaos with [b]The Bubbler[/b], your jetpack says a lot about how you bring the heat to the battlefield.


We want to know,
What’s your jetpack style?
🧑🏻‍🚀 [b]The Classic[/b] – Clean, cool, and chaos-ready
🫧 [b]The Bubbler[/b] – Fizzy, loud, and a little unhinged


🚀 Stay tuned for more deep dives into the weird and wonderful world of [b]Drunkonauts[/b].
And don't forget to wishlist on Steam! 👇

notes.title: Jetpacks, Vibes, and a Very Cool Nomination 🎉
notes.notes:
[h1]Award Nomination + Demo Progress – Things Are Getting Real[/h1]

Hello, explorers! Enchanted Crafts Studios (ECS) here, bringing some exiting updates today! 

[h2]✨ What’s New[/h2]
[list][*][b] RGA (Romanian Games Awards) Nomination — May 9, 2025 
[/b]Drunkonauts has been nominated for Best Upcoming Romanian Game at the Romanian Game Awards! Together with Nebula Developers Lab, we’ll be attending the gala on June 3rd. You can also catch part of the ECS team at Dev.Play on June 2–3.[/*][/list]
[list][*][b]Top community notes so far:[/b][list][*]"Lighting felt flat across maps"-> New lighting setups + better shadows on all maps[/*][*]“Hard to hear when I fall off the map” -> Fall sounds are now in place (gravity has a voice!)[/*][*]“Maps are too silent” -> Ambient VFXs and audio added for more atmosphere[/*][*]"Jetpack felt off sometimes”-> Thrust logic refined for smoother, more consistent behavior[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[h1]Drunkonauts Demo Is Live – Come Break Physics With Us & Shape the Steam Release[/h1]

Hello, explorers! We’re [i]Enchanted Crafts Studios[/i] and we’re teaming up with [i]Nebula Developers Lab[/i] to bring you [b]Drunkonauts[/b] — a chaotic multiplayer party brawler with hilarious physics-based combat!

Test-fly the jetpacks, throw around bottles of beer and hit your friends with crazy space weapons

"No visible indicator for the jetpack's cooldown" → Jetpack cooldown meter
"Hard to grab knocked down enemies" → Easier grab on rag-dolled foes  
"Knock down timer increases too drastically"→ A timer more balanced for more “down but not out” moments
[/list]
